About.title: A secure, orderly channel for your documents
About.intro: Element is a document management platform designed for organizations that need to share information with their clients in a controlled, traceable and private way.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.body: To provide a reliable space in which each person accesses only the documents that concern them, with clear rules and a complete record of every action.

approach.title: How we work
approach.body: Accounts are created and managed by the organization. Every file is verified before it is stored, downloads use temporary links, and administrators work with two-step verification.

commitment.title: Our commitment
commitment.body: We process personal data in accordance with Colombian Law 1581 of 2012 and its regulations, and we apply security measures appropriate to the sensitivity of the information we manage.

values.confidentiality: Confidentiality: access is limited to authorized people.
values.traceability: Traceability: relevant actions are recorded and cannot be altered.
values.availability: Availability: documents are always within reach of those who need them.
values.service: Service: clear and timely attention to each request.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what information Element collects, why, and how it is protected.

sections.heading: 1. Data controller
body: [PENDING: legal name of the organization], tax ID [PENDING], domiciled at [PENDING: address], email [PENDING: privacy contact email], is responsible for the personal data processed through Element.

sections.heading: 2. Information we collect
body: Account data provided by the organization (name, email address, preferred language).
Files and their descriptions uploaded by users or administrators.
Security records: sign-ins, IP address, browser type and actions performed, kept to protect accounts and investigate incidents.
Messages sent through the contact form.

sections.heading: 3. Purposes
body: To provide the document management service, authenticate users, send transactional emails (invitations, password resets and file notifications), keep the platform secure, respond to contact requests and comply with legal obligations.

sections.heading: 4. Service providers
body: Element relies on providers that process data on our behalf: Supabase (database, authentication and storage), Vercel (hosting), Resend (email delivery), Upstash (abuse prevention), Google reCAPTCHA (bot protection) and Sentry (error monitoring, without personal data or file names). Some of these providers store data outside Colombia. [PENDING: confirm regions and transfer agreements]

sections.heading: 5. Retention
body: Files moved to the trash are permanently deleted after 30 days. Security records and contact messages are kept for [PENDING: retention period].

sections.heading: 6. Your rights
body: You may exercise your rights to know, update, rectify and delete your data, and to revoke your authorization, as described in the personal data processing policy.

sections.heading: 7. Changes
body: We will publish any change to this policy on this page, indicating the date of the last update.

dataPolicy.title: Personal data processing policy
dataPolicy.intro: This policy is adopted in compliance with Colombian Law 1581 of 2012, Decree 1377 of 2013 (compiled in Decree 1074 of 2015) and other applicable regulations.

sections.heading: 1. Controller
body: [PENDING: legal name], tax ID [PENDING], address [PENDING], phone [PENDING], email for data requests [PENDING].

sections.heading: 2. Processing and purposes
body: Personal data is collected, stored, used and deleted to: manage user accounts; provide the document management service; send transactional communications; ensure the security of the platform and keep an audit trail; and respond to requests received through the contact form.

sections.heading: 3. Rights of data subjects
body: Under article 8 of Law 1581 of 2012, data subjects have the right to: (a) know, update and rectify their personal data; (b) request proof of the authorization granted; (c) be informed about the use given to their data; (d) file complaints with the Superintendence of Industry and Commerce; (e) revoke the authorization and/or request the deletion of data when the processing does not respect constitutional and legal principles, rights and guarantees; and (f) access their personal data free of charge.

sections.heading: 4. Authorization
body: Data is processed with the prior, express and informed authorization of the data subject, except in the cases provided by law. Authorization for contact requests is obtained through the form's acceptance box.

sections.heading: 5. Inquiries and claims
body: Inquiries will be answered within a maximum of ten (10) business days from their receipt, extendable by five (5) additional business days. Claims will be answered within a maximum of fifteen (15) business days, extendable by eight (8) additional business days. Requests must be sent to [PENDING: email or channel], indicating the data subject's identification, a description of the request and contact details.

sections.heading: 6. Area responsible
body: [PENDING: area or person responsible for handling requests from data subjects].

sections.heading: 7. Sensitive data and minors
body: Element is not intended to collect sensitive data or data of minors. If such information is included in documents, it will be processed only with the authorizations required by law. [PENDING: legal review]

sections.heading: 8. Transfers and transmissions
body: Data may be transmitted to the technology providers listed in the privacy policy, some of which are located outside Colombia, under conditions that guarantee an adequate level of protection. [PENDING: legal review]

sections.heading: 9. Effective date
body: This policy is effective from [PENDING: date]. Databases will be kept for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These terms govern access to and use of Element. By using the platform you accept them.

sections.heading: 1. Access
body: Anyone can create an account; the organization decides which accounts may upload documents. Credentials are personal and non-transferable; the user must keep them confidential and enable two-step verification when available.

sections.heading: 2. Acceptable use
body: It is forbidden to upload malicious content, files that infringe third-party rights, or information not related to the purpose of the service, and to attempt to access information or accounts of others.

sections.heading: 3. Files
body: Only the allowed formats are accepted, up to the published size and storage limits. Element may reject files that fail its security checks.

sections.heading: 4. Availability
body: We make reasonable efforts to keep the service available, but we do not guarantee uninterrupted operation. [PENDING: service level, if any]

sections.heading: 5. Suspension
body: The organization may deactivate accounts that breach these terms or for security reasons.

cookies.title: Cookie notice
cookies.intro: Element only uses cookies that are strictly necessary for the site to work securely. We do not use advertising, profiling or analytics cookies.

sections.heading: What are cookies?
body: Cookies are small files that a website stores in your browser to remember information between visits.

sections.heading: How to manage them
body: You can delete or block cookies from your browser settings. If you block the necessary cookies, you will not be able to sign in.
